context_needed: Ethiopia, SPIR graduation programme layered on PSNP4, endline survey February-April 2021 (about three years after the 2018 baseline). Arms (PDF p. 29): T1 = L* + N* (enhanced livelihoods + enhanced nutrition), T2 = L* + N, T3 = L + N*, control T4 = PSNP only; each arm is compared with T4. Estimand ITT; ANCOVA controlling for the baseline value of the outcome where measured (PDF p. 35 and table notes). Population: full endline household sample. Units: the notes say every outcome is inverse-hyperbolic-sine transformed, but the text (PDF p. 75) says only the continuous income and net-income measures are, so column (5), a yes/no outcome with control mean 0.325, reads as a share.

rule: ANCOVA tables are read like any ITT table: one row per arm and outcome, each arm against the pure control (T4), with the specification noted. The control-mean row and the test-of-equality rows are never stored. The meaning of parentheses can change within a table, so check the notes before reading a bracketed number as an SE.

resolved_questions.question: Units of column (5): the table notes say the inverse hyperbolic sine was applied to every outcome, but the text (PDF p. 75) says only continuous income measures were transformed, and column (5) is a yes/no outcome. This entry labels columns (1)-(4) and (6) '(IHS)' and leaves column (5) as a plain share. Confirm that reading.
